note: 'robust' here means significant across all 3 min-n multipliers at the fixed baseline band span (1000/2500) -- NOT across band-span choice too. Band spans use disjoint literal rating bands (categorical buckets), so a finding computed at one span is never the 'same finding' as one at another span; n_significant_by_band_span_at_baseline_min_n instead reports how the total count of significant comparisons differs by band span, as a separate, non-per-finding signal.
